leadText:
Travis (Japanese: コウジ Kōji) is a character of the day who appeared in a flashback in Pokémon Double Trouble. He is the son of Luana, the Gym Leader of Kumquat Island and the fourth member of the Orange Crew. He left his home to become a Pokémon Master.

Travis is a doppelgänger of , at least according to Luana. He is also similar to Ash in that he started his with a . Little else is known about Travis, as he only appeared in a flashback and had no speaking lines.
